body_markdown:
September brings a fresh crop of fragrance releases, and this month’s lineup has a little bit of everything. From creamy skin scents and juicy fruit to smoky woods, suede, and warm vanilla, these new arrivals reflect some of the biggest September fragrance trends right now. Whether your ideal scent is soft and intimate or bold enough for a night out, here are eight new fragrances to have on your radar.


## **[BLIND BARBER Shinjuku Mood](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/blind-barber-shinjuku-mood-152107105996025)**


Inspired by the neon-lit streets of Shinjuku, Shinjuku Mood balances tranquility with a darker, more sensual edge. Black currant and black tea create a deep, aromatic opening, while lavender, cedarwood, and suede give the fragrance a smooth, smoky finish.


## **[BLIND BARBER Speakeasy](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/blind-barber-speakeasy-99024762467062)**


Speakeasy feels like slipping into a hidden bar after dark. Lavandin and bergamot bring brightness to the opening, while tonka, sandalwood, and musk create a warm, smooth finish that feels made for an evening out.


## **[CLEAN RESERVE Sun-Kissed Papaya](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/clean-reserve-sun-kissed-papaya-280085014893438)**


Sun-Kissed Papaya captures the feeling of golden hour with a juicy, creamy blend of tropical fruit and soft woods. Papaya and sparkling mandarin brighten the opening, while coconut cream, vanilla, and tonka bean melt into a warm, skin-close finish.


## **[FORVR MOOD Not Your Type](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/forvr-mood-not-your-type-75237894029361)**


Bold and unapologetic, Not Your Type is a warm fragrance with plenty of attitude. White suede and iris petals create a soft, sophisticated opening before vanilla oud, tonka bean, and amber bring depth and sensuality to the scent.


## **[LAKE & SKYE 222](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/lake-skye-222-219677267287495)**


LAKE & SKYE 222 is the kind of fragrance that stays close to the skin. Frothed milk and almond blossom create a soft, creamy opening, followed by vanilla cream, bergamot zest, and airy musk for a velvety finish that feels intimate and comforting.


## **[MEMOIRE ARCHIVES Disco Party](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/memoire-archives-disco-party-3750)**


Disco Party smells like a night spent under neon lights with your favorite people. Lychee and pink dragonfruit bring a sparkling fruity opening, while jasmine, hibiscus, and sheer vanilla create a sweet finish that feels playful and carefree.


## **[MEMOIRE ARCHIVES Picnic In The Park](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/memoire-archives-picnic-in-the-park-3751)**


For something a little more tranquil, Picnic In The Park captures the simple pleasure of a sunny afternoon outdoors. Zesty lime and magnolia open with a fresh brightness, followed by green tea and cedarwood for a clean, airy finish.


## **[MICHEL GERMAIN Sugarful Pink Kiss](https://www.scentbird.com/perfume/michel-germain-sugarful-pink-kiss-150728742521722)**


Sugarful Pink Kiss is made for anyone with a serious sweet tooth. Juicy cherries, sugared raspberries, and lime create a sparkling opening, while jasmine, whipped cream, and pink vanilla make the heart rich and flirtatious. Soft musk and amber round everything out with a warm finish.
